title: When the Harbor Sings
author: Beatrix Villalobos
blurb: Paloma Okonkwo, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
